autogate.closedelay.tooltip: How long the gate stays open after you walk away. 60 ticks = ~1 second.
magnet.radius.tooltip: How far away items will be pulled towards you, in tiles.
magnet.speed.tooltip: How fast items move towards you. Higher = faster pickup.
sellprice.highlight.tooltip: Mark the most profitable processing option with an asterisk (*).
quickstack.key.tooltip: Press this to top up matching stacks in nearby chests with items from your inventory.
quickstack.radius.tooltip: How far around you chests are searched for matching stacks.
quickstack.moved: Quick stacked {{count}} items into nearby chests.
quickstack.nothing: No matching stacks found in nearby chests.
silo.enabled.tooltip: Override how much hay each silo holds. Off = vanilla (240 per silo).
silo.capacity.tooltip: Hay stored by each silo. Vanilla is 240. Applies to silos you already built.
species.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for the hover tooltip. Use the options below to choose what it applies to.
buildbags.enabled.tooltip: When building with Robin, materials stored in your Item Bags count towards the cost and are spent automatically. Requires the Item Bags mod.
species.crops.tooltip: Name planted crops and show whether they're growing, ready or dead.
species.trees.tooltip: Name wild and fruit trees and show stump, tapped, mossy and fruit state.
species.bushes.tooltip: Name berry, tea and golden walnut bushes.
kiln.enabled.tooltip: Lets the charcoal kiln burn driftwood, torches, wood and hardwood, each with its own yield and burn time. Replaces the vanilla 10-wood recipe.
totals.enabled.tooltip: While an Item Bag is open, hovering an item shows how many you own in total.
totals.chests.option.tooltip: Include every chest in the world in the total. Turn off if you notice a pause when hovering.
totals.bags.option.tooltip: Include items stored inside your other Item Bags in the total.
sellany.enabled.tooltip: Allow selling items the game normally refuses, such as furniture, wallpaper and big craftables. Tools, the scythe and quest items stay protected.
sellany.shipping.tooltip: Furniture and other blocked items can be placed in the shipping bin.
sellany.shops.tooltip: Also let shopkeepers buy anything, not just the categories they normally deal in. Off by default, since it lets you sell anything to anyone.
sellprice.scan.tooltip: Read the game's machine data so machines added by mods (Cornucopia, Wildflour's Atelier Goods, and others) show up in the tooltip too.
sellprice.max.tooltip: How many processing options to list, highest value first. Keeps the tooltip readable when many machines accept the same item.
sellprice.cornucopia.tooltip: List products from Cornucopia's artisan machines in the tooltip. Only shown because Cornucopia is installed.
sellprice.wildflour.tooltip: List products from Wildflour's Atelier Goods machines in the tooltip. Only shown because that mod is installed.
sellprice.professions.tooltip: Show what each product is really worth to you, including every profession bonus that applies to it (Artisan, Tiller, Rancher, Fisher/Angler, Tapper, Blacksmith, Gemologist) plus quality. Turn off to see plain base prices.
shoptrade.enabled.tooltip: Shops that trade goods for goods (the Desert Trader, the Island Trader) count items stored in your Item Bags towards the price and take them automatically when you buy.
sellprice.food.tooltip: Also list cooking recipes that use this item. Off by default: dishes take several ingredients, so their price isn't what this one item is worth.
cookbags.enabled.tooltip: Adds an Item Bags tab to Love of Cooking's kitchen, so ingredients stored in your bags can be cooked with. What you use is taken from the bag when you close the menu.
pinenuts.enabled: Pine Nuts From Any Tree Seed
pinenuts.enabled.tooltip: Cornucopia's Compact Mill also presses pine nuts from acorns and maple seeds (plus Stardew Valley Expanded's birch seeds and fir cones), at the same yield and press time as pine cones.
sellprice.itemvalue.tooltip: Show what the hovered item itself sells for, including its quality and your profession bonuses, plus the total for the whole stack.
bulkgeodes.enabled.tooltip: At Clint's geode counter, press the key while holding a stack to choose how many to break at once instead of clicking one at a time.
bulkgeodes.key.tooltip: Pressed inside Clint's geode menu, with a stack of geodes held.
monster.enabled.tooltip: Lets you summon a chosen monster, for quests that ask for kills you can't easily find. Off by default.
monster.name: Monster Name
monster.name.tooltip: Name of the monster to summon, e.g. Green Slime, Bat, Skeleton, Dust Spirit. Modded monsters work too.
monster.key.tooltip: Summons the monster around you. Also available as the console command: lmqol_spawn <name> [count]
monster.onentry: Also Spawn on Entering a Floor
monster.onentry.tooltip: Summon them automatically whenever you arrive on the mine floor set below.
monster.floor.tooltip: Which mine floor triggers the automatic spawn.
stuffbags.enabled.tooltip: Adds a button to the inventory page that sweeps loose items from your inventory and nearby chests into the Item Bags that accept them.
stuffbags.key.tooltip: Does the same as the button, from anywhere.
stuffbags.radius.tooltip: How far around you chests are searched. Set to 0 to only use your own inventory.
